stem: What was one reason for the expansion of machine politics in the late nineteenth century?

options.label: F
options.text: The rapid influx of immigrants made it difficult for local governments to provide basic services.

options.label: G
options.text: Federal restrictions prevented voters from influencing government decisions at the local level.

options.label: H
options.text: The economy was too tightly regulated to allow urban growth.

options.label: J
options.text: Settlement houses failed to help immigrants adjust to life in the city.
